pin.why: A2 §2: "The far run of coast where the Peatrun stains the sea brown a mile out, or so the wreck-reports swear." The committed spine node n-peatrun-coast is a child of n-coldreach, NOT of n-cluster1 — A1 (the basin) contains no peat at all — so this row is c03 with a literal `at` (t=0.840 inside Coldreach) and is never translated by PIN_OFFSET
